record.content: The site-specific listing identifies product 1154 as Arroyo Flats, a primitive overnight group camp for 17-75 people. It is a 0.25-mile hike from parking, has 15 parking passes with no overflow, permits two vehicles at the site when conditions permit and directs the other 13 to the parking lot, has no flush toilets or showers, and requires advance purchase of a $25 beer-and-wine permit if desired.
